newsitem.title: NORWAY: Norsk Hydro plans huge N.Sea spend - paper.
newsitem.headline: Norsk Hydro plans huge N.Sea spend - paper.

text.p: Operator Norsk Hydro ASA and its partners will spend about 60 billion crowns on oil and gas projects in the North Sea between now and 2000, the business daily Dagens Naeringsliv (DN) said on Thursday.
The plans include eight new platforms in addition to the five already in the pipeline, DN said.
The Njord development is the first project scheduled for completion in 1997, closely followed by the floating production Visund installation, which is due for start up in mid-1998, DN said.
